topic: UK student visa: Indians must show up to
hook: UK student visa: Indians must show up to *Rs 18 lakh*
hook_b: UK now wants Rs 18 lakh in your account. Still going?
tldr: UK student visa rules change from Nov 30, with Indians needing up to Rs 18 lakh for living expenses held for 28 days.

beats.what: NDTV Profit: applicants relying on personal funds must maintain the required balance for at least 28 consecutive days before applying.
beats.why: The visa gets costlier from Nov 30, per the headline.
beats.care: If you plan a UK Masters, your savings proof must sit untouched for 28 days.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV Profit: up to Rs 18 lakh for living expenses for Indians; 28 consecutive days of balance before applying. Exact tiers by city were not in the summary.

cards.q: UK visa is getting costlier. What will you do?
opts: Study in India, work abroad later
